title: Stay With Us
description: Evening light on the Emmaus road — recognition, burning hearts, and the joy of remaining with the risen Jesus.

title: Take My Yoke

title: Come and See
description: Jesus’ gentle invitation in John 1 — curiosity, encounter, and the beginning of discipleship.
